nodes.label: SessionContext
nodes.desc: Entry point that owns shared session state and offers sql() plus read_* helpers.

nodes.label: DataFrame
nodes.desc: Lazy select/filter/aggregate API whose collect() drives execution.

nodes.label: DFParser
nodes.desc: sqlparser-rs wrapper adding DataFusion DDL such as CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE.

nodes.label: SqlToRel
nodes.desc: Lowers the SQL AST into logical plans through a ContextProvider.

nodes.label: LogicalPlan
nodes.desc: Immutable relational-algebra tree of Projection, Filter, TableScan and friends.

nodes.label: LogicalPlanBuilder
nodes.desc: Programmatic plan construction that backs the DataFrame API.

nodes.label: SessionState::optimize
nodes.desc: Runs the analyzer and then the logical optimizer rules on each plan.

nodes.label: Optimizer rule catalog
nodes.desc: Documents the ordered analyzer, logical and physical rule sets shown by EXPLAIN VERBOSE.

nodes.label: DefaultPhysicalPlanner
nodes.desc: Rewrites an optimized LogicalPlan into a tree of ExecutionPlan operators.

nodes.label: ExecutionPlan
nodes.desc: Trait whose execute(partition) yields a stream of Arrow RecordBatches.

nodes.label: ParquetSource
nodes.desc: Parquet scan operator with row-group pruning and predicate pushdown.

nodes.label: ListingTableFactory
nodes.desc: Turns object-store paths into partitioned table providers.
